client_context.description: Optional IDE context. Supports selection text and optional dirty buffer overlay payload for L5.7.

dirty_buffers.description: Unsaved editor buffers eligible for deterministic overlay during Ask/Debug context assembly.

path.description: Workspace-relative file path for the unsaved buffer.

content.description: Full current unsaved content for the file path.

task_type.description: When EXPLAIN_DEBUG, backend may use real reasoning if selection and selected_file are present.

evidence_first.description: When true, WSL/runtime builds layer5.evidence_bundle.v1 from workspace-local index+retrieval; repo_root is workspace input path only. On failure, falls back to ContextEngine (see evidence_first_meta).

trace_id.description: End-to-end correlation ID for Ask (plugin → Plan-Gate → handlers → downstream); same value across v1 attempt and v0 fallback.
